gates.evidence: The proposal targets a premium feature upgrade screen (s03), which is a utility surface.
The reward is for playing a game; there is no reward for ad clicks or app installs.
The proposal offers a sampling of a premium feature without loss framing.
The user taps 'Play to try' or 'No thanks' on the offer card.
The offer card states: 'Play a 15-second game to unlock 10 minutes of 5x context for better memory today.'
The 'No thanks' button closes the offer, leaving the user on the paywall screen.
The offer is placed on the paywall page (s03), not during a chat interaction.
The proposal explicitly excludes subscribers: 'never shown to subscribers.'

scores.evidence: The trigger is the paywall screen (s03) where the user is blocked from the feature, maximizing relevance.
The reward provides a sampling of the premium feature without altering the baseline free chat experience.
The sample is small (10 minutes), time-boxed to 'today', capped (2/day), and clearly contrasted with the unlimited subscription.
COGS ($0.0018) is well below the net revenue per view ($0.009–0.015).
The offer is limited to users reaching the paywall, which is a significant but not universal subset of the user base.
Maps directly to SIM-RWD units with a simple chip addition on an existing screen.
Uses '5x context for better memory' and 'Janitor Plus' from the digest.
Caps of 2 per day with a 60-minute cooldown are safe and avoid nagging.
Defines holdout, primary metrics (conversion), and guardrails.

parsed.topConcern: None; the proposal is well-scoped and adheres to all policies.
